title: Buckets and object model

title: Erasure coding for durability
description: MinIO stripes objects with erasure coding across drives, surviving multiple drive failures without RAID. Durability comes from math, not hardware RAID cards. It is why MinIO runs on JBOD.

title: Versioning and object locking
description: Bucket versioning keeps every version of an object; object locking (compliance/governance modes) makes versions immutable for retention rules. Datasets get time travel; regulated data gets WORM. Both are bucket-level switches.
